notes: ENVIRONMENT LIMITATION (affects all keywords): the WebFetch tool was blocked for this entire run by the sandbox's outbound egress proxy, which returned HTTP 403 'policy denial' at the CONNECT stage for every domain tested -- not just tawuniya.com/qgirco's own site as anticipated, but also unrelated control domains (example.com, wikipedia.org, google.com, anthropic.com). This was confirmed via the proxy's own status endpoint showing org-wide connect_rejected denials. Per instructions, no attempt was made to route around it. As a consequence, every 'source_excerpt' field below was sourced from WebSearch's own result snippets/summaries rather than an independently fetched and verbatim-confirmed page body. Many appear to be genuine verbatim quotes (article titles, press-release lines, direct quotes, review text) that WebSearch itself surfaced in quotation marks, but none could be cross-checked against the live page as the task normally requires -- treat them as high-confidence near-verbatim rather than fetch-confirmed verbatim. Recommend re-running once WebFetch access is restored. Tawuniya and QGIRCO: as separately anticipated, their own domains (tawuniya.com.sa, qgirco.com) were expected to block automated fetches at the WAF layer; this could not be distinguished from the broader proxy outage this run, so third-party/news coverage was used for both per the task's fallback instructions. 'Beema' is a shared brand name across at least three unrelated entities; only Damaan Islamic Insurance Company 'Beema' Q.P.S.C. (the QCB-licensed, QSE-listed Qatari takaful insurer, ticker BEMA.QA) was treated as in-scope -- a separate UAE/Dubai insurtech (beema.ae, ENOC Group) and unrelated shopping/auction apps sharing the name were excluded. 'Alkhaleej Takaful' (AKTI, ticker AKHI.QA) was confirmed to be a Qatar-based, Qatar Exchange-listed Takaful insurer headquartered in Doha, not UAE-based as initially assumed; no separate UAE entity of the same name was found. Several sub-agents also hit their per-session WebSearch call budget (200 calls) before exhausting every planned follow-up query, which limited coverage of some minor/undated items and a few exact publication dates (reflected as published_at: null). No genuine Trustpilot, Reddit, or X/Twitter post content could be independently verified for several targets (e.g. Doha Insurance, QLM, Qatar Islamic Insurance, Alkhaleej Takaful, Qatar general market) beyond what WebSearch itself surfaced; where no substantive social content was found, no social_sentiment items are reported for that keyword rather than fabricating coverage.
